svg.title: HARP KV Eviction Policy Flow
svg.desc: Flowchart showing HARP eviction decision scoring, action selection, and decode-time prefetch overlap behavior.
svg.text: HARP Eviction Policy: Decision and Runtime Flow
Hierarchical Adaptive Residual Prefetch (NPU -> CXL/CPU with compression + grace window)
A) Eviction-Time Decision
1) Trigger
NPU KV memory is full while scheduling decode requests.
Build candidate pool from active decode requests (tail-compatible ordering).
2) Enumerate candidate actions per request
Action tuple a = (target tier, compression ratio, grace tokens).
Target tier: CXL first if available, else CPU.
Ratios default: [1.0, 0.75, 0.5, 0.25]; grace defaults: [16, 32, 64].
3) Score each action and pick minimum score
score = lambda_stall*stall + lambda_quality*quality + lambda_fairness*(debt/max(freed_bytes, eps))
stall: max(prefetch_time - grace_time, 0)
quality: sensitivity(request) * compression_penalty(ratio)
fairness: raises cost for repeatedly evicting the same request.
Tie-breakers: prefer larger raw bytes freed, then smaller stored bytes.
4) Apply chosen action
Free raw bytes from NPU; allocate compressed bytes on CXL/CPU.
Set request state to SHADOW if grace tail kept, else COLD.
Start background prefetch bookkeeping and update fairness debt.
B) Decode-Time Runtime Behavior
5) Continuous background prefetch progress
Each scheduler tick moves bytes from CXL/CPU toward NPU readiness.
Tracks overlapped bytes when grace tokens are still active.
If transfer completes, prefetch_remaining becomes zero.
6) Admission control for next decode step
If prefetch_remaining == 0 OR grace_tokens > 0: request is schedulable.
Else request stalls; stall time/event counters are incremented.
This is where HARP avoids hard stalls when overlap succeeds.
7) On each decode token
Update token-time EMA used in future stall predictions.
If request is SHADOW: count shadow-hit token and decrement grace.
When grace reaches zero, state transitions SHADOW -> COLD.
8) Completion and metrics
On request finish: free resident NPU bytes and any leftover tier bytes.
Logs per-request and tier-level metrics:
stall_time, stall_events, shadow_hit_tokens, overlap_ratio, avg_shadow_ratio.
These metrics quantify whether grace+prefetch actually hid latency.
Source implementation: inference_serving/eviction_policies/harp.py and inference_serving/scheduler.py
